policy: Twenty distinct content-inspected primary/technical documents and API references. R12 is an official public preview. Foreign guidance is not automatically Nepal project law. Multiple pages of one document count once.

sources.title: Seismic Design of Buildings in Nepal, Second Revision
sources.locator: Annex A 2.1–2.2 (PDF 81); Annex A 4.3(c), Eq4.3.3 (PDF [91, 92]); Annex A 4.5.1(h) (PDF 98); Annex A 4.5.1(i) (PDF 99)
sources.application: Minimum concrete M20; M25 where building height exceeds12m. Higher-strength TMT bars need elongation>14.5%; actual ultimate/yield or0.2%proof ratio>=1.15. A grade label alone does not verify these actual properties. Ash is cross-sectional area of the BAR forming links/hoops. h is longer outer dimension of rectangular link,<=300 mm. Acc is entire outer confined core regardless of hoop arrangement. No textual permission here to add outer-plus-diamond leg areas to Ash; any alternative interpretation needs engineer verification. Mechanical couplers permitted. They must conform to contemporary international codes/standards/practice; if established codes unavailable, verify by testing compatible with required ductility. This clause does not itself specify a numeric tensile strength criterion. Welding prohibited in critical yielding regions; do not weld links/ties/inserts to required vertical reinforcement.
sources.limitations: Annex A RC lateral systems. Section 4.1 earthquake-effect beams factored axial compressive stress<=0.08fck; secondary beams exempt. Section 4.2 earthquake-effect columns stress>0.08fck. Confirm adopted project edition, system, loads/stress classification.
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded and text read; key NBC105 pages rendered and visually checked

sources.title: NBC110:1994 — Plain and Reinforced Concrete
sources.locator: Foreword
sources.application: Nepal amendments to IS456:1978 Third Revision; subsequent IS456 revisions do not apply automatically until specifically recognized.

sources.title: NBC205:2024 — Ready-to-use Detailing Guideline for Low-rise Reinforced Concrete Buildings without Masonry Infill
sources.locator: Scope/foreword, PDF7–8; application limits, PDF15–17
sources.application: First complete revision replacing1994. CategoryC ordinary residential, regular bareRCframe, no infill contribution; <=12m or3storeys; other plan/bay/regularity/soil/material constraints apply.
sources.limitations: Built using NBC105:2020; related standards explicitly include IS456:2000 andSP34:1987. Not a universal commercial/multistorey template. Confirm authority/project transition to2025.

sources.title: NBC201:1994 — Reinforced Concrete Buildings with Masonry Infill
sources.application: Reprint2064; ordinary residential regularRCframe with structural masonry infill of prescribed distribution. Original coefficient0.128; <=11m or3storeys, bays<=4.5m, direction<=25m/6bays and panel<=13.5m2, plus other constraints.
sources.limitations: Historical infilled-frame template. Does not establish scope for Basanti; do not transplant material/member schedules.
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded and text read; key NBC105 pages rendered and visually checked

sources.title: NS191:2046 Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement, First Revision2069
sources.publisher: Nepal Bureau of Standards and Metrology; official Gandaki Infrastructure Development Office host
sources.locator: 1.1, notes (PDF 5); 5.2, Table 1 (PDF 12); 6.2.1 (PDF 13); 7.1, Table 3 (PDF 14); 8.3, Table 4 (PDF 16); 8.4.1 (PDF 17)
sources.application: Covers Fe415/415D,500/500D,550/550D,600. D denotes enhanced elongation at the same specified yield/proof grade. Nominal kg/m values for length-based steel quantities. Nominal mass uses0.00785kg per mm² of cross-section per metre, equivalent to7850kg/m³. Delivered mass tolerances are separately in Table 2. Fe500D: yield/proof>=500 MPa; elongation>=16%; tensile>=1.10 times actual yield/proof and>=565 MPa. This does not by itself guarantee NBC105 actual ratio>=1.15. BEND TEST mandrel for Fe500/500D:4φ up to and including22 mm;5φ above22 mm. This is a material test, not automatically a fabrication minimum. REBEND TEST mandrel for Fe415/415D/500/500D:5φ up to10 mm;7φ above10 mm. Not automatically a fabrication requirement.
sources.limitations: Material acceptance standard, not structural sizing or fabrication-detail approval. Confirm NS mark, actual MTC/test properties and adopted revision.
sources.verification: Actual official-host PDF text read in web PDF parser; local download returned503; screenshot timed out. NBSM current catalog lists NS191:2046, and government landing page explicitly identifies this revision; no later revision was verified.

sources.title: Design of Concrete Structures, Module6 Lesson 15: Bond, Anchorage, Development Length and Splicing, Version 2
sources.application: IS456:2000 plain tension bond stress for M25=1.4 MPa; deformed bars multiply by1.6; compression bond multiplier1.25. Ld=φσs/(4τbd). At0.87fy, assumedFe500/M25 gives48.5491φ; NBC105 table49φ should govern that selected Nepal table check. Illustrates IS2502/SP16 standard hook/90° bend using kφ internal radius: k>=2 mild steel,4 cold-worked steel; depicted straight tail>=4φ. These historical categories do not automatically classify modern Fe500D TMT. Anchorage VALUE of bend4φ per45° (max16φ) and U-hook16φ is structural anchorage credit, not arc length or a cutting-length deduction. Bearing inside bend additionally depends on force, internal radius, bar spacing and concrete strength. General IS456 splice discussion differs from NBC105 seismic requirements; do not combine its smaller-bar lap basis or nonseismic allowances with NBC105 larger-bar tension lap rule.
sources.limitations: Primary university teaching notes explaining IS456:2000; not a Nepal approval or full current amendment set. Prose contains oversimplified percentage descriptions; use explicit equations and verified Nepal table.
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded and read; figure6.15.3 rendered and visually inspected.

sources.title: An Overview of Revisions in IS456:2000: Code of Practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete
sources.publisher: Government of India, Ministry of Railways, RDSO
sources.locator: 2.4.3, underlyingIS4568.2.3 (PDF 6); 2.8, underlyingIS45612 (PDF [10, 11]); 3.10.4, underlyingIS45626.4 (PDF 19)
sources.application: Cover includes links; durability exposure and required fire period both determine cover. BBS required for reinforcement; cover tolerance+10/−0 mm; no reduction below specified cover. Column longitudinal nominal cover>=40 mm and>=bar diameter; narrowly restricted200 mm/smallbar exception. Footing cover>=50 mm. Durability cover depends on exposure rather than member label; fire may also control.
sources.limitations: Government technical commentary onIS456:2000, not full standard or proof Nepal adopted that edition. It does not reproduce fullTable16/16A, so this review has not independently established beam30 mm as a universal requirement.
sources.verification: Actual official PDF text inspected in web parser; local fetch503.

sources.title: Checklist for Concrete Mix Design, CAMTECH/2021/C/CONCRETE MIX DESIGN–CHECKLIST/1.0
sources.publisher: Government of India, Ministry of Railways, CAMTECH
sources.locator: 7.2, Table 3 reproducingIS456Table3 (PDF 10); 7.2.1, Table 4 reproducingIS456Table5 (PDF 10); 10,12 (PDF [11, 12])
sources.application: Defines exposure categories; moderate includes rain/condensation, continuous water and nonaggressive soil/groundwater. Project exposure still requires assessment. For reinforced concrete with normal-weight20 mm aggregate in moderate exposure: minimumM25, cement>=300kg/m³, maximumfree w/c0.50. These are durability limits, not a complete batching recipe. Target mean strength based on characteristic strength, standard deviation andX; chosen w/c checked against durability limit. Material densities, aggregate grading, moisture and trials determine mix quantities.
sources.limitations: Concrete mix context rather than rebar detailing; M25 is a transparent trial basis, not source approval or a justification for fixed nominal1:x:y batching.
sources.verification: Actual official PDF content read in web parser; local fetch503.

sources.title: Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works2073, with amendment2075
sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport, Department of Roads
sources.application: Use appropriate mechanical benders and cold slow steady bending; check supplied bending schedules and work to drawing. Source first sentence prints IS2052, while labelling sentence refers toIS2502; retain this apparent source typo instead of silently rewriting it. Correct drawing dimensions, fixed cover spacers, checked bar shape/size/diameter/count. Splices only where shown on drawing or agreed by engineer; lengths as drawing or directed. No heating and bending of high-yield bars; bars toIS1786/high-tensile bars are not to be bent after placing in works.
sources.limitations: Road/bridge contract workmanship context, not automatically a building design basis. No numeric universal fabrication mandrel obtained.
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded, cover and reinforcement section read.

sources.title: EC2 Webinar Autumn2017 Lecture9: Reinforced Concrete Detailing to Eurocode2
sources.locator: EC2 8.3 / lecture9-2 (PDF 2); EC2 8.3 / lecture9-3 (PDF 3); EC2 8.4.3 / lecture9-5 (PDF 5)
sources.application: Inside mandrel diameter to avoid bar damage:4φ forφ<=16 mm,7φ forφ>16 mm. Foreign-code comparison only. Separate concrete-bearing minimum φm,min>=Fbt*(1/ab+1/(2φ))/fcd unless all specified exemptions met. Bar-damage mandrel minimum alone is not a complete anchorage/bearing check. Bent-bar required anchorage length measured along bar centreline. Distinguish this geometric length from horizontal projection.
sources.limitations: Eurocode2/BS8666 guidance, not a verified adopted Nepal fabrication standard; do not combine its anchorage factors with NBC105 coefficients.
sources.verification: Official institute PDF downloaded/read; relevant pages rendered.

sources.title: CARES Guide to Product Certification, Part 6: Fabrication of reinforcement
sources.locator: p.3 British Standards; p.4 Fabrication processes: Cutting and Bending; p.5 CARES Scheme for Fabricators
sources.application: Add explicit standard edition, shape convention, material grade, dimensional tolerance and source revision fields. Preserve a mill/batch reference separately from calculated nominal mass. Do not silently turn a sharp polyline into a fabricated shape.
sources.limitations: UK fabrication guidance, not Nepal project authority. Its ±25 mm is not an adopted Basanti tolerance or allowance to add to every cut. This document is counted once, not once per section.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: ACI 315R-18: Guide to Presenting Reinforcing Steel Design Details (official preview)
sources.publisher: American Concrete Institute / Joint ACI-CRSI Committee 315
sources.locator: §1.1–1.2 Introduction and Scope; §3.1 BIM; §3.2.1 Tolerance considerations; §3.2.2 Concrete cover
sources.application: Separate design requirements, calculated geometry and review status; check cover against tube outer surfaces rather than centreline points. Keep tolerance envelopes and accessory envelopes visible in selected-member QA.
sources.limitations: Only the public preview was inspected. Do not claim access to detailed clauses beyond it or use uninspected ACI 117 numerical tolerances. US guidance does not replace the applicable Nepal/BIS basis.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: Reinforcing Bar Couplers — UK & Ireland Edition
sources.locator: pp.8–9 Tapered Thread Standard Series; pp.10–11 Tapered Thread Positional Series; p.14 Accessories / calibrated torque wrenches
sources.application: Make a coupler an explicit end treatment with product/type, bar sizes, thread preparation, insertion/engagement and manufacturer instruction revision. Validate coupler outside diameter in cover/congestion geometry. Keep product preparation allowance separate from finished installed length.
sources.limitations: Product-specific manufacturer instructions. Neither the +25 mm allowance nor torque values are universal rebar rules; no Ancon product is selected or approved for this project by citing the brochure.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: Reinforcing Bar Placing
sources.locator: Placing Drawings; Bar Spacing; Bar Supports; Bar Tying Requirements
sources.application: For each bar mark, show member/location, orientation, repeated count and station/spacing basis on the placing view. Keep chairs/supports and ties identifiable instead of treating a count-only table as a complete placing instruction.
sources.limitations: This is a process/placement reference, not a numerical development, hook, tolerance or structural design standard. It does not make an application-generated BBS issued.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: BS 8666:2005 Shapes Guide
sources.publisher: CADS Support Team (official CADS information guide, reproducing BSI material)
sources.locator: Table 3, pp.3–7: centreline length versus scheduled dimensions; p.7 Note 1: approximate equations and true central-axis length; p.7 Shape 99 dimensioned sketch and free dimension; p.8 Table 5: legacy tolerance convention
sources.application: Use exact line-and-arc geometry for the new engine, make outer/inside/centreline dimension convention explicit, and expose a dimensioned shape sketch. Never add arc length to untrimmed sharp-corner leg totals.
sources.limitations: This is an old 2005-edition manufacturer guide, included only to illustrate geometry/dimensioning conventions. Do not adopt its old shape formulas, minimum radii or tolerances as current Basanti or BS 8666:2020 requirements. The project standard must be separately chosen and verified.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: Design of Concrete Structures, Module 11 Lesson 28: Foundations — theory and design
sources.application: Footing cover and development are checked at the column-face critical section, together with bearing, shear and site conditions. Supports the explicit centred development comparison and its limited scope.
sources.limitations: Primary university explanation of IS456:2000; not Nepal project approval. Cover may increase for groundwater or aggressive chemicals. No bearing capacity or column force is inferred.
sources.verification: Official PDF opened and relevant pages read, 28 October 2026

sources.title: WebGLRenderer API reference
sources.locator: Introduction: WebGL 2 / r163; debug.checkShaderErrors and debug.onShaderError; compileAsync; getDrawingBufferSize / getSize / setSize; dispose / forceContextLoss / forceContextRestore
sources.application: Record actual renderer/version/capabilities, keep development shader diagnostics on, verify a nonzero drawing buffer, render populated scenes after state changes, and dispose abandoned GPU resources.
sources.limitations: Successful construction or a CSS-visible canvas alone is not a 3D rendering pass. Test the application’s pinned Three.js version; a working vector fallback is a separate outcome.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: WebGL capability utility API reference
sources.locator: WebGL.isWebGL2Available(); WebGL.getWebGL2ErrorMessage()
sources.application: Check WebGL2 availability before initializing the current renderer and distinguish unsupported, initialization-failed, context-lost and running states. Keep a readable geometry/table path available when WebGL2 is unavailable.
sources.limitations: This documents a separate API module from WebGLRenderer. Availability is only a preflight signal, not proof that a complex scene, shader or GPU allocation will render successfully.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: WebGL 2.0 Specification
sources.locator: Context Creation and Drawing Buffer Presentation; Context Creation steps 6–7; The Drawing Buffer
sources.application: Exercise genuine context-creation failure and reduced-capability environments. Record actual context attributes and dimensions rather than assuming requested antialias/depth values imply success.
sources.limitations: The retrieved document explicitly labels itself an editor’s draft/work in progress. Use it as primary API-behavior reference with that status, not as a project engineering standard. The older 2.0.0 page also carries draft wording.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research

sources.title: WEBGL_lose_context — Khronos Ratified Extension Specification
sources.locator: Overview; New Functions: loseContext(); New Functions: restoreContext()
sources.application: Add an end-to-end loss/recovery test after loading a selected member and a trial cage. Verify explicit state transition, controls/selection survival and a populated frame after recovery, or deliberately switch to a clearly labelled fallback and dispose/remove the abandoned canvas.
sources.limitations: The extension may be unavailable. Do not call restore and immediately assert the context is ready; wait for the restored event and verify actual rendering.
sources.verification: Primary document inspected in read-only research
